newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Martinair buys new MD11 aircraft.
newsitem.headline: Martinair buys new MD11 aircraft.

text.p: Dutch airline Martinair said on Monday it was expanding its fleet with the purchase of a McDonnell Douglas MD 11, due for delivery in December next year.
With a freight capacity of 85 tonnes, the new aircraft would help bolster Martinair's position on the international freight market, particularly in the summer months, Martinair said.
It said summer demand for freight was still growing.
After taking delivery of the new aircraft, Martinair, a 50-50 freight and passenger joint venture between Dutch carrier KLM and transport firm Nedlloyd, will have a 12-strong fleet.
It will comprise two Boeing 747-200Cs, one Boeing 747-200F, four MD 11CFs two MD-11Fs and six Boeing 767-300ERs.
